name: Dropbox
summary: Easy start in development mode, but there's a clock: once 50 users link your app you have two weeks to get production approval or new users are blocked.
scenario: An agent that reads and organizes files in users' Dropbox accounts.

composio.note: Check the Composio managed OAuth directory for the Dropbox toolkit.

policyAndDomain.detail: Production review contents were not visible on the pages checked.

userCapBeforeApproval.detail: Development apps link up to 500 accounts; after 50 linked users you have two weeks to get production approval.

adminApproval.detail: No admin step described for individual accounts.

appReview.detail: Production approval is needed to share publicly; requests are reviewed once you have 50 linked users.

time.note: Dropbox says it responds to nearly all production requests within a few business days.

nextStep: Create a scoped app in the App Console with the narrowest access type, pick the final app name now (you can't rename after production), and add your redirect URI.

prerequisites.text: Pick the final app name before applying for production; renaming afterward requires a support ticket.

steps.title: Create a scoped app
steps.detail: App Console → Create app → Scoped access, choose App folder or Full Dropbox, and name it.

steps.title: Select permissions and redirect URI
steps.detail: On the Permissions tab tick only the scopes you need; add redirect URIs on Settings.

steps.title: Enable additional users for testing
steps.detail: On the app's info page, enable additional users so accounts beyond yours can link during development.

steps.title: Apply for production early
steps.detail: Submit the production request before you hit 50 users; it won't be reviewed until 50, but the two-week clock starts then.

steps.title: Monitor linked users
steps.detail: Track linked-user count so you don't miss the window. An agent can set up the reminder.

review.summary: Production approval, reviewed once the app reaches 50 linked users.
reviewersCheck: Not listed on the pages checked
review.meanwhile: Up to 500 accounts in development, subject to the 50-user window.

blockers.issue: New users can't link the app.
blockers.fix: You passed the two-week window after 50 users without production approval. Apply and contact Dropbox support.

nuances.text: Production review won't start until the app has at least 50 linked users, even if you apply earlier.

uncertainties: The developer guide's production approval section was not reachable from the research environment; criteria are unconfirmed.
Scope names and console steps come from general knowledge, not a page checked in this pass.

sources.title: Dropbox forum (staff answer): development user limit
